newsitem.title: USA: Agouron's says drug to be made available.
newsitem.headline: Agouron's says drug to be made available.

text.p: Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc said its HIV protease inhibitor VIRACEPT(R) will be made available to HIV-infected children aged 2 to 13 years through an expanded access program.

Encouraged by preliminary evidence of safety and tolerability from an ongoing study of VIRACEPT in children, the company will make the drug available without charge to any HIV-infected child until the drug is approved for marketing in the United States.
Expanded access programs represent an effort by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to make investigational drugs available at the earliest opportunity for certain people.
